title: Chien-Pao shades
body:
A datapack that gives Chien-Pao some sick shades.
Thats it.

### How to Install:
To install the pack, make sure to copy the zip file to both the resourcepacks folder in your Minecraft instance and in the datapacks folder in your world's save data. Once installed.
